properties.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where ChangeType == "new"
| extend
    DNSDomain = Hostname,
    RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| where RiskCategory in ("highest", "high")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    DomainResultId,
    Subject,
    Hostname,
    DNSDomain,
    Risk,
    RiskCategory,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType,
    Tags,
    IpAddresses,
    Registrar,
    Domain,
    AreaId
properties.description:
Identifies newly reported Domain Detection results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest so updates for the same DomainResultId do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.
properties.name: Netcraft Domain Detection - High risk result

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: New Domain Detection result {{DomainResultId}} for {{Hostname}} reported risk {{RiskCategory}}. See the ChangeType custom detail for the change that triggered it.
